title: Anatomy of Motion: Comparative Gait Analysis Lab
description: An interactive 3D biomechanics classroom where students compare the walking gaits of a realistic human (CesiumMan) and a robotic humanoid (Xbot). Users control playback speed, toggle skeletal overlays, place measurement markers on joints, and answer quiz questions about locomotion differences to earn a completion score.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive biomechanics education lab. Load CesiumMan.glb on the left and Xbot.glb on the right, positioned 3 units apart on a grid-textured ground plane. Both models should play their default walk animations using THREE.AnimationMixer. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at (0, 1.5, 5) looking at the midpoint between models, with OrbitControls limited to prevent going below the floor. Add a HemisphereLight (sky 0x8ecae6, ground 0x444444, intensity 1.2) and a DirectionalLight with soft shadows. Build an HTML/CSS overlay UI panel on the left side with these interactions: (1) A shared playback speed slider (0.1x to 2.0x) that adjusts both AnimationMixer timeScale values simultaneously. (2) A 'Toggle Skeleton' button per model that uses THREE.SkeletonHelper to show/hide bone wireframes overlaid on each character. (3) A 'Place Marker' mode toggle: when active, raycasting clicks on either model place small colored spheres (red for CesiumMan, blue for Xbot) on the clicked surface point, with a counter showing markers placed (minimum 3 required on each model to proceed). (4) A 'Measure' button that, when two markers exist on the same model, draws a dashed line between the last two placed markers and displays the distance in a floating HTML label. (5) A 'Quiz' button that opens a modal with 3 multiple-choice questions about gait biomechanics (e.g., 'Which model exhibits more lateral sway?'). Validate each answer, highlight correct/incorrect, and track score. (6) A 'Complete Lab' button enabled only when: playback speed was changed at least once, both skeletons were toggled on at least once, at least 3 markers placed per model, at least one measurement taken, and quiz score is 2/3 or higher. On completion, display a congratulatory banner with the final score and animate both models to a celebration pose by increasing animation speed to 1.5x. All parameter thresholds must be validated before enabling completion.
